summary_1line: Bhishma recounts teachings on warrior honor, battle ethics, military formations, strategy, and the heavenly rewards of fearless combat.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Janaka reveals visions of radiant heavenly realms and dark hells to his assembled warriors before battle.
A vast army forms ranks with elephants in front, chariots behind them, cavalry next, and armored infantry in the rear.
Warriors swear an oath together before battle, raising weapons and vowing to conquer or die.
